exit_codes.meaning: conflict, precondition failed, or ambiguous reference

rules: run wait is level-triggered and returns the triggering items
only an explicit report settles an attempt
ledger mutations deduplicate --request-id; session dispatch does not
session references accept UUID, unique UUID prefix, title or project/title
session send submits only with hook-confirmed idle; queue rejects replacement
session wait uses events; idle is not proof of completed work
session wait --for takes a comma list; idle|waiting|working are agent-only, exit fits every session
inside a Forge session --project defaults to the caller's checkout and spawn --provider to the caller's agent
a launch prompt plus --context is capped at 64 KiB; session send stays at 8 KiB
spec takes a Claude artifact link, a Markdown path or the text; a missing path exits 4
self and parent are session references relative to FORGE_SESSION_ID
session watch prints one JSON line per change, not one object
session exec types one line only while the shell owns its terminal's foreground
a malformed --timeout is a usage error; waits default to 600s unless a global --timeout is given
a launch refused after creating a worktree names it in details.worktree_created
review start --wait exits 0 only when the run completes; failed, cancelled or interrupted runs exit 1
review start --model and --effort override [review] model and effort; unset uses the provider's own default
